title: Opus 5 Just Killed Prompt Injection: 0% Attack Success
description:
Opus 5 just shut down prompt injection, the biggest hole in AI agents 🔥

129 browser agent scenarios, 0% successful attacks. Turn the defense layer off and attacks land 3.7% on Opus 5, 2.8% on Fable 5. Auto Mode uses two barriers: scans data before the model sees it, then blocks risky actions befre they run.

OpenAI said publicly this probaby can't ever be fully solved 😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
